stories.title: Belgian air traffic strike grounds flights
stories.summary: Most flights to and from Belgium were canceled Monday as air traffic controllers joined a national day of union action. Provider skeyes reported insufficient staff to handle traffic safely, forcing the cancellation of most arrivals and departures. The notice was provided late on Saturday.

stories.title: Jordanian Airline Considers Launching Flights to Kazakhstan - Caspian Post
UK and US align on aviation safety and technology
stories.summary: The UK and US have agreed to strengthen cooperation on airspace management, transport innovation, and passenger connectivity. Following talks in Washington, officials highlighted the importance of aviation links for trade and tourism, while also discussing recent air traffic control outages in both countries.

stories.title: Air China deepens Zagreb service cuts
stories.summary: Air China has brought forward frequency reductions on its Beijing to Zagreb service via Bucharest. Flights will drop to two weekly until mid-December, with a further reduction to one weekly flight scheduled from late December until the summer season. The route currently includes a stopover in Bucharest.

stories.title: Archer Aviation clears hurdle for Los Angeles flights
stories.summary: Archer Aviation has received a Market Survey Special Airworthiness Certificate from the FAA for its electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, Midnight. The company plans to begin piloted operations in Los Angeles later this month, aiming for passenger flights ahead of the 2028 Olympic Games.

stories.title: Public anxiety rises amid infrastructure outages
stories.summary: Recent outages and system failures have prompted public concern regarding the stability of critical infrastructure. The situation has drawn comparisons to historical periods of domestic instability, where calls for immediate government action were common. Anxiety remains high as officials navigate the increasingly complex landscape of national systems.

stories.title: Air Serbia expands summer network
stories.summary: Air Serbia plans to add 150 weekly flights and six new destinations for the 2027 summer season, including Miami and Helsinki. The carrier is increasing frequencies on existing routes, with Zagreb services set to rise gradually from June. The airline expects to add several thousand seats per week.

stories.title: Delta system outage delays thousands of flights
stories.summary: A technical problem with Delta's automated weight and balance system delayed roughly 2,000 flights on November 22. Staff relied on manual workarounds until the issue was resolved in the afternoon. The airline confirmed that the outage was not the result of a computer hack.

stories.title: Noida airport lacks international passenger flights
stories.summary: Eight months after its inauguration, Noida International Airport has yet to host a scheduled international passenger flight. The facility, intended as a second aviation hub for the National Capital Region, is currently experiencing a decline in passenger footfall and a limited roster of operating airlines.

stories.title: Boeing shares dip following Philippine Airlines order
stories.summary: Boeing stock traded at 144.64 EUR on Monday, down 0.97 percent from Friday's close. The decline follows the company's agreement to supply Philippine Airlines with 15 787-10 jets, with an option for five additional aircraft. Deliveries are scheduled to take place over the next decade.

stories.title: IndiGo launches Mumbai to Dar es Salaam route
stories.summary: IndiGo has launched daily non-stop flights between Mumbai and Dar es Salaam, becoming the only Indian carrier to serve the route. The service is part of a broader effort by Tanzania to attract increased trade, investment, and tourism from Asia.

stories.title: Aviation security faces wildlife trafficking challenge
stories.summary: Airports are increasingly tasked with detecting illegal wildlife products, such as shark fins, hidden within global air cargo. While aviation security traditionally focuses on explosives and terrorism, the transport of illicit goods has emerged as a persistent operational challenge for international networks.

stories.title: Emirates tops global airline rankings
stories.summary: TIME has named Emirates the world's best airline for 2027, followed by Qatar Airways and Air New Zealand. The rankings, produced with Statista, evaluated passenger experience and operational performance using surveys and flight data. Indian carriers IndiGo and Air India Express were recognized in the reliability category.

stories.title: Arch Systems Wins $7.8 Million Coast Guard Aviation Logistics Support Task - Homeland Security Today
FAA ground stop creates confusion for VFR pilots
stories.summary: A nationwide ground stop last week highlighted a lack of clear communication for general aviation pilots. The FAA did not specify if VFR operations were included in the order, leading to inconsistent enforcement across the country. Pilots were left to determine their own status during the event.

stories.title: Air India and Airbus partner on SAF program
stories.summary: Air India and Airbus have signed an agreement to develop a corporate sustainable aviation fuel program in India. The framework focuses on voluntary procurement of SAF on select routes, allowing the airline to offer Scope 3 certificates to corporate customers interested in reducing their carbon footprint.

stories.title: Tata Sons reviews Air India performance
stories.summary: The Tata Sons board recently reviewed Air India's performance and transformation progress. Executives presented plans to the board at the airline's headquarters in Gurugram. The review comes as the carrier continues to work through an extensive program intended to address ongoing financial losses.

stories.title: Airlines May Have To Charge AI Agents To Search Their Fares - Aviation Business Middle East
Wizz Air workforce surpasses 10,000 employees - Airline Routes & Ground Services
SpiceJet pilots urge government intervention
stories.summary: The Federation of Indian Pilots has requested that the Civil Aviation Minister intervene in SpiceJet's ongoing financial and operational crisis. The association warned that the airline's condition poses risks to aviation safety, passengers, and staff, calling for a comprehensive review of the carrier's financial health and regulatory oversight.

stories.title: XPeng shifts focus to long-range electric aviation
stories.summary: As China expands its technological ambitions in physical AI and advanced mobility, competition is moving toward complex forms of long-range electric aviation. The sector is increasingly looking beyond short-range, low-altitude demonstrations to address the demands of more sophisticated flight operations.

stories.title: Korean Air earns 10th consecutive APEX Five-Star Global Airline rating - Airline Routes & Ground Services
UK and US strengthen transport cooperation on aviation - Airline Routes & Ground Services
airBaltic restructuring: Oleg Evdokimov calls for government intervention over Chapter 11 plan - Airline Routes & Ground
Pilots seek flight curbs for SpiceJet
stories.summary: The Federation of Indian Pilots has asked the government to verify SpiceJet's proposed 5,500 crore rupee fundraise and assess its maintenance and crew capabilities. The association warned that prolonged financial stress could compromise aviation safety and requested an urgent review of the airline's ability to operate its schedule.

stories.title: Endeavor Air offers direct path to Delta
stories.summary: Endeavor Air allows eligible pilots to advance to Delta Air Lines without additional interviews or testing. Under its Career Advancement Program, pilots become eligible for this transition after completing 24 months as a captain. The pathway provides a clear route for those seeking long-term positions at major carriers.

stories.title: Kazakhstan, Algeria Sign Aviation Deal to Expand Air Links - Caspian Post
Archer Aviation pivots to defense
stories.summary: Archer Aviation has begun selling electric engines and batteries for defense aircraft and plans to acquire Boeing's drone maker, Insitu. While the company is known for air taxis, its stock has lost 61 percent over the last twelve months. Defense work has not yet halted the decline.

stories.title: IndiGo flight diverted to Lucknow
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Pune to Patna was diverted to Lucknow early Monday due to bad weather in Bihar. Flight 6E 653 carried 187 passengers and six crew members. The aircraft landed safely at 2:45 am, with plans to resume the journey to Patna later in the morning.

stories.title: Pilots’ body seeks curbs on SpiceJet operations amid financial and safety concerns - TravelBiz Monitor
SpiceJet crisis deepens as pilots seek help
stories.summary: The Federation of Indian Pilots has asked the government to examine SpiceJet's financial crisis, citing concerns over safety, unpaid dues, and maintenance shortages. The airline is struggling with cash-flow issues and spare-part shortages that have grounded many aircraft. The carrier has not commented on the staff pay delays.

stories.title: Bad weather forces IndiGo flight diversion
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Pune to Patna was diverted to Lucknow airport early Monday due to poor weather conditions. Flight 6E 653 carried 187 passengers, including five infants, and six crew members. The flight was scheduled to continue its journey to Patna later on Monday morning.

stories.title: Police report airline miles theft
stories.summary: Newtown Township police reported a theft complaint involving airline travel miles between November 13 and 19. The incident was documented alongside a separate DUI arrest in the area. The report did not specify the total value of the miles or the circumstances surrounding the alleged theft.

stories.title: SpiceJet cancels majority of flights
stories.summary: SpiceJet has cancelled over 70 percent of its scheduled flights across three regions as its financial and operational crisis continues. The cancellations have left thousands of passengers stranded. The airline remains under pressure as it faces mounting debt and ongoing scrutiny regarding its ability to maintain operations.

stories.title: Travelers face holiday delays
stories.summary: Travelers at the Albuquerque International Sunport faced flight disruptions as the Thanksgiving week began. The delays follow a recent nationwide FAA ground stop and a separate equipment outage at Delta Air Lines. Shoppers in the area also faced a 6 percent increase in costs for holiday dinners.

stories.title: Helicopter altitude procedures ignored at DCA
stories.summary: A National Academies committee reported that controllers at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport assigned no altitudes to helicopters during four days of operations last week. The committee noted similar deficiencies during the January 2025 midair collision. The FAA has been reviewing the capital's airspace procedures.

stories.title: Federal agencies issue aviation security alert for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The FBI, DHS and TSA have warned airlines and airports about terrorist messaging tied to a recent attempted hijacking. Officials state there is no known credible threat to US aviation, describing the notice as a concern for the industry rather than a warning of a specific attack.

stories.title: Pune-Patna Indigo flight diverted to Lucknow due to bad weather - Udayavani
Archer Aviation shares fall as losses widen
stories.summary: Shares of Archer Aviation are down more than 52 percent this year as investors weigh high cash burn against production goals. The company reported a $274.6 million loss in the third quarter, more than double its loss from the same period in 2025.

stories.title: Surf Air Mobility targets software and electric aviation
stories.summary: Surf Air Mobility is attempting to pivot its commuter airline network into a distribution channel for proprietary software and electrification platforms. The company aims to boost margins through these new businesses, though both rely on technology that has yet to reach commercial scale.

stories.title: Tokushima Indigo Socks players visit tomato farm
stories.summary: Newly signed players for the Tokushima Indigo Socks visited a local tomato cultivation facility in Awaji City to learn about agriculture. The team says the event was part of a regional contribution activity that also included teaching baseball to local elementary and middle school students.

stories.title: Cybersecurity expert warns of AI-driven software flaws
stories.summary: Cybersecurity expert Nicole Perlroth suggests recent major U.S. outages may be a preview of future instability. She notes that AI is currently identifying software flaws faster than they can be patched, potentially accelerating the frequency of system failures.

stories.title: Delta System Glitch Throws Thousands of Flights Into Chaos at Atlanta Airport Ahead of Thanksgiving: What - Benzinga
Foreign airlines request delay for Long Thanh airport move
stories.summary: Foreign airlines are seeking to defer their transition to the new Long Thanh airport in Vietnam. The request follows broader industry discussions regarding the readiness of the facility for international operations.

stories.title: IndiGo flight diverted to Lucknow due to weather
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Pune to Patna was diverted to Lucknow early Sunday due to unsuitable weather conditions at the destination. The aircraft landed safely with 187 passengers and five infants on board.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing share of DC-based generation, storage and loads has increased interest in DC microgrids. As a result, DC-bus voltage regulation and stability have become active research topics, with considerable effort directed at improving the transient. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A 3D PINN-Based Framework for Patient-Specific Pulmonary Hemodynamics Using Windkessel Models
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cardiovascular fluid dynamics modeling relies heavily on mesh-based numerical methods such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). While accurate, these methods entail significant computational costs and complex meshing workflows that limit their translation to clinical practice. Physics-Informed. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A boundary integral equation solver for capsule suspensions
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Deformable capsules serve as models for biological cells, such as red blood cells, as well as for synthetic capsules in biomedical and industrial applications. In this work, we introduce a framework for fast and robust simulation. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A new restitution model for wet particle collisions using fully resolved numerical simulations
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Particle collisions play a central role in wet particle processes such as granulation, drying, and chemical reactors, yet the influence of the liquid on the collision dynamics remains insufficiently understood. research.title: Active Learning of Flows from Curve Observations using Gaussian Processes
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The active learning of real control systems requires informative roll-outs of controls. In this paper, we present a local optimization algorithm that finds the trajectory that most reduces uncertainty about the flow of a control system. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Augmentation of cardiovascular flow measurements with generative diffusion models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Cardiovascular imaging offers several ways to measure blood flow, but each provides an incomplete, resolution-limited, or noisy view of the underlying dynamics. Reconstructing the missing information is inherently ambiguous because several flow fields may be compatible. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
